text:
What is the electromotive force (e.m.f.) of a cell?
A
the charge that passes through the cell per unit time
B
the energy supplied per unit charge as charge passes through the cell
C
the total charge flowing through the cell
D
the total energy stored in the cell

options.label: A
options.text: the charge that passes through the cell per unit time

options.label: B
options.text: the energy supplied per unit charge as charge passes through the cell

options.label: C
options.text: the total charge flowing through the cell

options.label: D
options.text: the total energy stored in the cell
